Bolt Action will be available on PC (Steam, GOG, and Epic Games Store).

Tiny Bookshop is available now for iOS and Android, alongside the game being available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, and PC (Steam).
title: Tiny Bookshop - Official Mobile Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
ShoreTiles gets a new trailer showcasing gameplay and a release date. Watch the latest ShoreTiles trailer for this upcoming game that blends tile-placement strategy, resource management, settlement building, and RTS-style combat. ShoreTiles will be available on PC via Steam on September 3, 2026.

During the day, players purchase tiles from a trader, which are placed in a randomized deck to be placed at sea in order to shape the island to your own style and liking. Flick through farms, settlements, walls, military camps, and braziers, positioning tiles carefully to support growth, gain extra coins from matching tile-types, all the whilst preparing the island for the dangers that arrive after dark.
title: ShoreTiles - Official Release Date Trailer

description:

Players can get the rundown on the suite of modes and features coming with the game, from 12 playable characters, rollback netcode, ranked matches, and more. Master the elements in Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game, launching on July 23 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam), with an eventual release on Nintendo Switch and Nintendo Switch 2.

description: Lost in Tandem is available now on Steam. Watch the Lost in Tandem launch trailer for this 2D adventure-puzzle game where a young girl and a lost “Mech-ute” robot journey together through a post-apocalyptic world.

author: GameTrailers
description:
Take another look at gameplay and more from Factory Default: Build, Trade, Repeat in this latest trailer for the upcoming management strategy sim game. The new trailer showcases the game's blend of global industrial strategy, deep production chains, and corporate management. Factory Default: Build, Trade, Repeat will be available in Steam Early Access on September 8, 2026.

In Factory Default, you build and manage a worldwide industrial conglomerate, controlling every step of the production process—from extracting raw resources and refining materials to manufacturing advanced goods and trading them across a fully explorable 3D model of Earth. Inspired by real-world geography and resource distribution, every region presents unique opportunities for expansion, specialization, and profit.
title: Factory Default: Build, Trade, Repeat - Official Early Access Release Date Trailer

description: Take a look at the Gameplay Trailer for Little Sheep Valley, a Mediterranean farm management game developed by Redknot Games. Little Sheep Valley is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Little Sheep Valley - Official Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the Two Point Hospital: Full Health Collection console announcement trailer for sim game to see what to expect with the complete collection of DLCs for Two Point Hospital, featuring new locations, new hospitals, new items, new gameplay, and more. The Full Health Collection features the Culture Shock, A Stitch in Time, and Speedy Recovering DLCs, introducing 9 new hospitals, new gameplay mechanics, and over 80 new illnesses to cure. The Full Health Collection also includes the Bigfoot, Pebberley Island, Close Encounters and Off the Grid expansions, in addition to free items, including the Retro Items Pack, Fancy Dress Pack, and more. 

Two Point Hospital: Full Health Collection will be available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, and Nintendo Switch 2 on September 16, 2026 (digitally), with physical copies available on PlayStation 5 (PS5) and Nintendo Switch 2 on November 6, 2026.
title: Two Point Hospital: Full Health Collection - Official Console Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Get a deep dive into Rick Strowd's moves in this latest Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves trailer for the fighting game. Rick Strowd (voiced by Alejandro Saab) will be available in Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves on July 23, 2026. Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves is out now on PlayStation 5 (PS5), PlayStation 4 (PS4), Xbox Series X/S, Steam, and Epic Games Store.

Rick started out wowing casino crowds as a show boxer before going on to win it all on the world stage. The undisputed champ now spends his days defending the title belt, yet somehow still feels strangely unfulfilled. Then the news arrives: King of Fighters. A chance to tear through the ennui—and the world—once again. The champion's fists can break through anything...even the fangs of a wolf.
title: Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves - Official Rick Strowd Character Breakdown Trailer

description: Don't miss the Demo Release Date Trailer for Farm Hand, a cozy roguelike deckbuilding game developed by Bean Queen Games. Players will lay down the harvest to line up combos and run up the score. Plant new seeds, execute on synergies, and think strategically to ensure a successful harvest. Farm Hand is coming soon to PC (Steam), with a demo launching on August 5 for PC (Steam).
title: Farm Hand - Official Demo Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Squad-building bullet heaven Yet Another Zombie Survivors leaves Early Access on August 20. Launches on Steam, GOG, PlayStation, and Xbox, with Nintendo Switch coming soon after.

After selling over 600,000 copies and earning 13,000+ Steam reviews with a 91% Very Positive rating during Early Access, Yet Another Zombie Survivors is leaving Early Access on August 20. The 1.0 launch arrives simultaneously on Steam, GOG, PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Xbox One, and Xbox Series X|S, with the Nintendo Switch version following shortly after.

Version 1.0 is the game's biggest update yet, introducing some features rarely seen in the genre, including main story and side missions, a HUB area, a brand-new Survivor, a new map, a new game mode, arena bosses, plus plenty of new achievements, challenges, and more.

Awesome Games Studio, the dedicated developer behind this community-driven title, has one more surprise for players. To celebrate the Yet Another Zombie Survivors release date reveal, the
title: Yet Another Zombie Survivors: Official 1.0 Release Date Trailer

Zombuds is coming soon to PC (Steam), with a demo available now on Steam.

description: Black Lake is a first-person horror game where you search for your missing twin sister inside an abandoned orphanage lost at sea. Use candles, stealth, and weapons; explore its flooded halls; uncover the fate of its vanished children; and survive the thing they became. Wishlist it on Steam if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4928600/Black_Lake/
title: Black Lake - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Take a look at gameplay from Langrisser: Sea of Sword in this latest trailer for the next fantasy tactical RPG in the Langrisser series. Learn about the character and see tactical gameplay from Langrisser: Sea of Sword in this new trailer. Langrisser: Sea of Sword is developed by BlackJack Studio (the original team behind Langrisser Mobile), with a new score by composer Yasunori Nishiki. 

In Langrisser: Sea of Sword, you become the Nameless, a figure searching for lost memories from the shadows. Alongside a mysterious white-haired girl, you rise from mire and mist into a world of shifting loyalties, impossible choices, and nations standing on the brink. Across the mist-shrouded sea, hidden currents begin to stir, and a new saga unfolds.

Classic strategy is the key to breaking through the chaos. Amid the flames of war, every move, every formation, and every decision will shape the course of fate.

Langrisser: Sea of Sword is set for a global multi-platform release across iOS, Android
title: Langrisser: Sea of Sword - Official Gameplay Trailer
